integrity: The profile criterion is proved directly from the crown adjacency relation. The enumerator is obtained by an exhaustive case partition of complement profiles; finite exhaustive checks are corroborative only.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to standard crown graphs \(\operatorname{Cr}_n\) with \(n\ge3\). The finite verifier checks only \(n\le9\); the general statement rests on the analytic proof. A residual originality risk is non-indexed crown-specific literature not returned by focused searches.
title: Restrained-dominating-set profile of crown graphs
